measurementPolicy: Null denotes unmeasured. YouTube storyboard thumbnails are 320x180 previews sampled at nominal 10-second intervals, NOT pixel-perfect arcade frames or exact transition times.

regions.note: Terrain already visible in nominal 40s preview; not its entry time.
Both mountain peaks visible by nominal 110s preview; boundary pixels unmeasured.

secondaryFrameEvidence.description: Floor and ceiling visible, screenshot width 800px, no calibrated camera X.
Floating rock and ceiling/floor, no overlap alignment.

videoAlignmentAttempt.terrainComparisonRegion: uncalibrated repeated top and bottom strips
videoAlignmentAttempt.note: Repeating terrain texture and mostly black frames yield ambiguous 0px vs 48px shift correlations; do not accumulate to world coordinates.

cameraVideoCalibrationV2.method: terrain-color horizontal overlap matching across consecutive 5 fps samples
cameraVideoCalibrationV2.scrollDirection: right camera translates through terrain; scene shifts left
caveats: The matching mask uses brown/orange/green terrain; animation and scenery changes raise match error.
Do not infer source map X, source map Y or Unity KM from this measurement.
5 fps limits precise pause onset; bracket is an alignment fit, not a frame-perfect scroll controller trace.

videoRelativeCoordinateFramework.name: VIDEO_RELATIVE_SCROLL_PX_FROM_T40
videoRelativeCoordinateFramework.origin: video screen x=0 at recording t=40s
videoRelativeCoordinateFramework.uncertaintyNotice: extrapolation based on aggregate scroll rate, not a fully chained multi-frame verified feature track

videoDerivedBoundaryDraft.notes: Border-connected terrain color segmentation; median over at least two observed frames. Excludes mountain protrusions and hatch/robot geometry. Validate images before collision use.

videoPanorama.method: sampled 5Hz; earliest newly exposed video columns
videoPanorama.notes: Local evidence panorama is not an original arcade map; moving sprites and repeated terrain can appear as streaks. Use for guide only.
